name: Reticle lock and decode
looks: A macro subject fills the frame while a thin bracket reticle locks onto one point of interest and tightens as the camera pushes in. Beside the bracket a small mono label flickers through scrambled characters before locking into a real status word, with a live numeric readout ticking beside it.
build: DOM bracket over the target point, its corner gap narrowing on power2.out as the plate scales up for the push-in. The label scrambles per frame (kit.rng(frame*31+i*7)) and locks each character on a staggered time, same mechanic as end-card-decode. The numeric readout is a pure function of time with no easing, same mechanic as live-readout-hud (kit.setText from floor(rate*t)).
sound: A soft electronic chirp as the bracket tightens and locks, a few data ticks as the readout updates.
prompt: Open tight on a macro, textured subject with a thin bracket reticle that locks onto one point and tightens as the camera pushes in. Beside it, run a small status label through a quick character scramble before it locks to a real word, with a live number ticking under it, so the opening feels like something is actively sensing the subject.
